subject: Invoice signatory roles, billing contact handoff and portal onboarding proposal
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice signatory roles, billing contact handoff and portal onboarding proposal

Hi Julie,

Following our call this morning — thanks again for the time. A short note to propose a concrete handoff approach so we can move to e-invoicing without breaking AP's current payment cadence. Key decisions we need: who is the canonical invoice issuer at Redwood, whether Acme wants invoices pushed to the portal (preferred) or emailed as PDF copies, and any specific signatory/ remit fields Acme requires for SEPA/ACH reconciliation and VAT tagging.

Our proposal (minimal risk, low friction):
- Redwood invoice issuer: Redwood Inc. (billing@redwood.com). Invoice PDF + e-invoice XML pushed to Acme portal endpoint; if portal is not activated within 14 days we fallback to PDF email to finance@acme-corp.com with invoice XML attached.
- Signatory: we will include an "Authorized by" field (name + role) and a contact phone/email for AP questions. Reductions to the signatory field can be accomodated if Acme requires a specific legal signatory.
- VAT/Tax: we will include VAT rate and VAT registration ID per line item and a VAT summary block. Please confirm whether Acme needs a separate VAT evidence PDF.
- PO enforcement: we can include PO in the invoice header and reject if missing (configurable). We suggest a 30-day grace period to avoid payments hold during initial rollout.

Action items:
1) Please confirm preferred delivery: portal push (SFTP/API) OR invoice-email fallback.
2) If portal, share the onboarding contact and preferred test window (we propose Wed 10/28 09:00-11:00 PT).
3) Any required signatory language or fields (example: "Invoice received without PO will be rejected").

Attached is a small workbook with the invoice fields we plan to emit (redwood-invoice-template-acme-v1.xlsx) and a draft portal activation checklist.

Thanks — happy to loop in Connor on the API details if you want technical runbook.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood-invoice-template-acme-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) | portal-activation-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Julie Park <julie.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice signatory roles, billing contact handoff and portal onboarding proposal

Hi Vivek — thanks for the clear proposal. A few clarifying Qs from the AP side before we confirm: 

1) Portal activation: Acme prefers API push but our security team requires SFTP signed certs for initial ingestion. Can Redwood push both XML + PDF to SFTP?
2) Signatory: For EU entities we need the legal signatory name and company registration number on the invoice PDF — that cannot be a generic "Authorized by" line. Can you include a block for legal signatory on EU invoices while keeping a simpler line for US invoices?
3) VAT evidence: yes, we need a VAT evidence PDF attached for any invoice with VAT > 0.
4) PO enforcement: Agreed on a 30-day grace period, but AP will require a field for "PO received on" in the XML so our ingestion can tag exceptions programmatically.

Also, who will be the Redwood contact for urgent payment/query escalations? Please supply a single email and a backup.

We can aim for the test window you propose (10/28) if Redwood can support SFTP and the EU signatory block. Once we have the SFTP credentials and a test file, we will confirm.

Thanks,
Julie Park
Lead, Accounts Payable
Acme Corp

[received attachment: Acme-SFTP-spec-v2.pdf (reference)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Julie Park <julie.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.f@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.o@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice signatory roles, billing contact handoff and portal onboarding proposal

Thanks Julie — good points. Quick answers and an internal deployment note so Connor/Naomi can action: 

- Delivery formats: Yes, we can emit both SFTP (push of zipped payloads: invoice.pdf + invoice.xml + vat-evidence.pdf when applicable) and an API endpoint. We'll prepare an SFTP drop (mutual cert) test bundle to your spec. Connor, can you prepare an SFTP test bundle and sample XML that includes the "po_received_on" and a configurable "legal_signatory" block per entity?

- Signatory per region: we will include a conditional legal_signatory block in the invoice PDF and XML for EU-registered accounts; US/ROW will include the simplified "Authorized by" line. Naomi, please add schema notes to the workbook attached.

- VAT evidence: we will attach VAT evidence PDFs when VAT > 0. Naomi, confirm retention policy (we propose 7 years, encrypt-at-rest per Redwood policy).

- Escalation contact: primary: billing@redwood.com (monitored M-F 06:00-18:00 PT). Backup: revenue-ops-duty@redwood.com (rotating). We'll add both to the invoice header and the portal metadata.

Proposed timeline:
- Wed 10/21: Connor builds SFTP sample and posts test bundle to shared drive.
- Wed 10/28: Live test window with Acme (SFTP mutual cert).
- Wed 11/11: Cutover to automated portal delivery with 30-day PO grace enforcement.

Connor/Naomi — can you reply here with confirmations on sample file and retention encryption notes?

Thanks,
Vivek

[attachment: portal-activation-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Julie Park <julie.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice signatory roles, billing contact handoff and portal onboarding proposal

Vivek / team — all sounds good and aligned with our security gating. We confirm:

- Delivery: SFTP push is primary; please send the cert thumbprint and sample bundle when ready.
- Signatory block: EU legal signatory + company reg number required — Acme will validate during ingestion.
- VAT evidence: required as an attached PDF when VAT applies.
- Escalation: billing@redwood.com as primary contact is acceptable; please also add a mobile number for urgent holds.
- Test window: 10/28 09:00-11:00 PT confirmed.

Attached is a short AP onboarding checklist (Acme-onboarding-notes.pdf) with our test-case scenarios and the SFTP endpoint details. We will provide our PO-injection test files prior to 10/28.

Please keep me posted on the cert thumbprint and the sample bundle link.

Cheers,
Julie Park
Lead, Accounts Payable
Acme Corp

[attachment: Acme-onboarding-notes.pdf (pdf) | Acme-SFTP-endpoint.txt (text)]
